svg.title: Slots turned into gates
svg.desc: The twelve playing slots of the THINNING figure become gates; its three rests stay empty. With velocity 7 V, velocity variation 80%, duration 80% and duration variation 80%, higher-ranked slots get louder and longer gates: rank 12 plays 8.3 V for 71% of its slot; rank 1 plays 2.0 V for 21%.
